boundaries.name: HashCallbacks
boundaries.obligation: `Environment.keccakWords` (plonky2_keccak / `builder.keccak256`), `poseidonWords` (`PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64`) and `twoToOne` are opaque callbacks; no injectivity or collision resistance is assumed or proved.

boundaries.name: ProofSoundness
boundaries.obligation: `Environment.proofAccepted` is opaque plonky2 verification; that an accepted previous chain proof came from a gate-satisfying step is the premise encoded by the `Chain` inductive, never a theorem.

boundaries.name: ConsumerVdPin
boundaries.obligation: An initial step's declared verifier data is a free witness (`initial_step_vd_unconstrained`); only `check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data` in a consumer pins it (`verified_chain_uses_the_circuit_verifier_data`).

boundaries.name: InitialStatePin
boundaries.obligation: `initial_channel_reg_hash_chain` / `initial_channel_tree_root` / `initial_channel_reg_count` and an initial step's `block_number` are free inputs; binding them to the contract's pending registration chain, channel tree and count is a consumer obligation outside these files.

boundaries.name: MerklePathBinding
boundaries.obligation: The channel Merkle siblings are prover-supplied; that the path is authentic and that re-rooting changes only slot `channel_id` rests on Poseidon collision resistance, which is not assumed.

boundaries.name: PaddingRecipientNotPinned
boundaries.obligation: The circuit pins the identity components of inactive slots to zero but never their `recipient` limbs (and never any slot's recipient), so recipients are bound only by equality of the keccak chain with L1 (`gates_leave_recipients_free`); native `validate()` is stricter than the circuit here.

boundaries.name: ContractDelegatedChecks
boundaries.obligation: Nonzero and pairwise-distinct active `pk_g` are not constrained in-circuit; the source delegates them to `IntmaxRollup.registerChannel` through equality of the keccak chain.

boundaries.name: GoldilocksWitnessRange
boundaries.obligation: `PoseidonHashOut::try_from(Bytes32)` cannot fail (`native_canonicality_check_cannot_fail`), so a registration whose 64-bit identity halves exceed the Goldilocks modulus passes native validation and is only rejected by having no satisfying witness; the field range is a premise (`NativeWidths.identityFields`).

boundaries.name: SolidityKeccakPacking
boundaries.obligation: `solidity_keccak256` packing each u32 word as four big-endian bytes is assumed (`KeccakBridge`, `RollupValue.HashEncodingAgrees`); under it the fold preimage is byte-identical to the IntmaxRollup model (`fold_preimage_matches_rollup_model`).

boundaries.name: FieldAndGadgetLowering
boundaries.obligation: Goldilocks arithmetic, `range_check`, `split_le`, `safe_split_lo_and_hi`, `select`, `is_equal`, the keccak/Poseidon gadgets and `from_pis` slicing are modeled as Nat equations on reduced values; the plonky2 lowering is not proved.

boundaries.name: NativeProofNotChecked
boundaries.obligation: `to_public_inputs` never verifies the supplied previous proof, only parses its public inputs; verification is a premise of `native_assignment_satisfies_gates`.

boundaries.name: VdCanonicity
boundaries.obligation: `vd_from_pis_slice` and `PoseidonHashOut::from_u64_slice` read field elements from u64 with no canonicity check; verifier-data words are carried as an opaque `List Nat`.
